content.text:
A form should feel like a conversation.

One question at a time. Space to think. A little personality.

That’s Openform—an open-source form builder you can self-host.

Watch the demo, then build your own:
https://arjunkshah12345-hash.github.io/openform/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=openform_launch&utm_content=draft_2

media.altText: Openform launch film. Animated demonstrations of the editor, one-question-at-a-time forms, responses, CSV export, and MIT-licensed source.
